blockLooks.note: concourse and hall terrazzo (large worn tiles)
hall walls: the facade cream tile
shed end walls and tunnel mouths
balconies (painted iron decks; the green ironwork is kit)
stainless carriages (the red line and windows are kit)
the generator housing in hazard paint
the signal box walls (glazing is kit)
the signal box rails and levers

hazards.note: the scheduled express: warn 4 s (signal red, rails sing, headlight in the tunnel), pass 2.2 s end to end, lethal in the pit
live rail strip along the pit centre, gapped at the barrow crossing; cut by the signal box levers
live only beyond the stalled train (the train shorted the middle)
arcs into the flood when live
0.35 m of water on the bed: slows, conducts the rail when it arcs
a sparking signal cabinet: a 1 s fizz warning, then a 2 m arc
a burst steam main (the Ward gas kind): 2 s hiss, 3 s scald
boss encounter only: shard falls with a 1.2 s shadow telegraph
